title: Second CT pair: high foreground overlap coexists with 3/22 instance recovery
claim: On a purposively selected second raw-CT pair, Astra medium recovered the dominant persistent liver lesion at both visits and one new lesion: 3/22 instances, 1/7 links and 2/15 exact event groups. Foreground Dice was 0.799/0.891 but equal-instance Dice 0.107. A reported vessel exclusion coordinate lies inside a missed new reference lesion, supporting at least one recognition/inclusion disagreement relative to GT; other omissions remain mixed search/recognition.
limitations: One purposively selected patient and one fresh attempt, not population accuracy or a model ranking.
Source annotators used clinical reports; the solver intentionally received CT only. Clinical malignancy/reference interpretation was not independently adjudicated.
All 22 survey panels were presented, but this does not establish attention to every lesion; two-slice averaging and downsampling can obscure detail.
Conditional link/event success concerns only detected endpoints.
No merger/disappearance case or localized follow-up was tested; no frozen scores or labels were changed.
